rust_summary: notify native mods when a chat suggestion is applied.
doc_summary: `native_chat_suggestion_applied(original, start, end, suggestion, input)` reports a chat completion after Tab or a click. The range is in UTF-16 units of the list's original input, including when cycling; input is the resulting length-limited field value. Client-only, read-only. Bundles need "hooks": @API:chat_suggestion_applied@.
